title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
authors: Harsh Gupta, Guanya Shi, Wenzhen Yuan

tldr.zh: LUCID 从人类视频学习闭环预测物体三维点轨迹与掌心位姿，再由程序化仿真训练的通用臂手策略结合实时观测，将这些参考转为机械臂关节增量和“抓握协同＋手指残差”，并通过共享意图接口连接不同机器人本体。
tldr.en: LUCID learns closed-loop object-point and palm-pose trajectory prediction from human video, then uses a generalist arm–hand policy trained in procedural simulation to turn these references and live observations into arm-joint increments and coordinated grasp motions plus finger residuals, linking different embodiments through a shared intent interface.

evaluation_scope.zh: 接口：高层以最近两帧 RGB-D、物体上 16 个当前三维查询点及当前掌心位姿为输入，每秒预测未来一秒八个时刻的物体点轨迹与掌心位姿，形成参考 R。低层：学生策略以 R、实时物体点、腕部深度及本体／动作历史为输入，将点轨迹与深度编码为 tokens，通过本体状态查询的注意力及 MLP，以 50Hz 输出 27 维动作：6 维机械臂关节增量、5 维抓握协同系数、16 维手指残差；手指增量为 E×协同系数＋残差，E 是人类抓握重定向数据的五维 PCA 基底。臂手增量累加到上一关节目标，经平滑限位交给 PD；掌心参考作为网络条件，非直接相加的腕部基础动作。训练：意图模型按任务用人类视频监督；低层独立用程序生成物体与参考训练 PPO 教师，再以 PPO＋动作蒸馏训练可部署学生，教师额外读取仿真状态，学生使用相机与本体观测。部署更新参考与动作，不在线更新权重；同一本体复用通用控制器，跨本体共享意图模型但分别训练低层。验证：LEAP 手上搅拌、擦拭、归箱各使用约两万网络视频片段；Push-T 与线缆布置各用一小时手机视频，并在手／夹爪两种本体上评测。搅拌仍需外部停止，遮挡与不稳定抓握会导致失败。项目页提供方法与示例，代码、数据及预训练权重开放状态未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: Interface: two recent RGB-D frames, 16 current 3D object query points and current palm pose produce an eight-step, one-second object-point/palm reference R at 1 Hz. The student consumes R, live points, wrist depth and proprioceptive/action history; point/depth tokens are read by proprioception-conditioned attention and an MLP. Its 50-Hz, 27-D output comprises six arm-joint increments, five grasp coefficients and 16 finger residuals. Hand increments are E times coefficients plus residuals, with E a five-component PCA basis of retargeted human grasps. Increments accumulate on previous joint targets and undergo smoothing/clipping before PD control; palm references condition the network rather than being added as wrist base actions. Intent models train per task on human video. Independently, procedural objects/references train a PPO teacher with privileged state, then a deployable student with PPO plus action distillation and camera/proprioceptive observations. Deployment updates references/actions without weight updates. A task-agnostic controller is reused within each embodiment; intent transfers across embodiments while controllers train separately. LEAP stirring, wiping and binning each use about 20k web clips; Push-T and cable routing each use one hour of smartphone video and are evaluated with hand/gripper controllers. Stirring needs an external stop; occlusion and unstable grasps remain failure modes. The project presents methods/examples; code, data and pretrained-weight availability is unverified.
